studies.Population: Participants in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial
studies.Ethnicity Basis: Default: no protocol-mapped specific country or population was established
studies.Reference: Metabolomic Analysis of Renal Cell Carcinoma in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
studies.Authors: McClain KM, Sampson JN, Petrick JL, Mazzilli KM, Gerszten RE, Clish CB, Purdue MP, Lipworth L, Moore SC
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: A total of 531 metabolites were measured in non-fasting serum samples collected at the first PLCO screening arm follow-up visit.

sample_size.excerpt: The Sociodemographic, lifestyle, and medical history characteristics of the 534 participants are presented by case–control status in Table 1 .

comparison.excerpt: ORs correspond to RCC risk at the 90th percentile compared to the 10th of log metabolite intensity

design.excerpt: To identify RCC-associated metabolites, we conducted a 1:1 matched case–control study nested within the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial.

timing.excerpt: We, therefore, conducted metabolic profiling of pre-diagnostic sera from a nested case–control study of 267 RCC cases and 267 controls in the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial.

continent.excerpt: The PLCO Cancer Screening Trial is a population-based, multi-center, randomized screening trial of >150,000 US men and women aged 55–74
